title: Azure Basics — Core Services for Developers
title_es: Azure Básico — Servicios Core para Desarrolladores
description: Runnable companion for the Azure basics guide: a bootstrap script that provisions a resource group, storage account, App Service plan, web app, Key Vault, and managed identity with the Azure CLI.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la guía básica de Azure: script de bootstrap que aprovisiona un resource group, storage account, plan de App Service, web app, Key Vault y managed identity con la CLI de Azure.
